questions.question: In 2023, how many million vehicle miles were traveled on rural interstate highways in Alabama?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_vehicle_miles_by_functional_system_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Alabama'].iloc[0]
result = float(row[1])

questions.question: Which three states had the highest total vehicle-miles of travel across all functional systems in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_vehicle_miles_by_functional_system_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
start_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Alabama'].index[0]
end_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Wyoming'].index[0]
states_df = df.loc[start_idx:end_idx].copy()
states_df[17] = pd.to_numeric(states_df[17])
top3 = states_df.sort_values(by=17, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].tolist()
questions.check_program:

states_df[17] = pd.to_numeric(states_df[17], errors='coerce')
top3 = states_df.sort_values(by=17, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].tolist()

questions.question: Between California and Texas, which state reported more total rural vehicle miles traveled in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_vehicle_miles_by_functional_system_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
ca = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California'].iloc[0]
tx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Texas'].iloc[0]
result = 'California' if float(ca[8]) > float(tx[8]) else 'Texas'

questions.question: How many states (including the District of Columbia) logged more than 100,000 million total vehicle miles in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_vehicle_miles_by_functional_system_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
start_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Alabama'].index[0]
end_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Wyoming'].index[0]
states_df = df.loc[start_idx:end_idx].copy()
result = int((pd.to_numeric(states_df[17]) > 100000).sum())

questions.question: Did rural highway travel account for more than 50% of the total vehicle miles traveled in Montana in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_vehicle_miles_by_functional_system_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
mt = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Montana'].iloc[0]
rural_total = float(mt[8])
grand_total = float(mt[17])
result = 'yes' if (rural_total / grand_total) > 0.5 else 'no'

questions.question: What was the combined total vehicle miles traveled across Maine, New Hampshire, and Vermont in 2023, in millions?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_vehicle_miles_by_functional_system_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
states = ['Maine', 'New Hampshire', 'Vermont']
sub = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(states)]
result = round(float(pd.to_numeric(sub[17]).sum()), 4)
